description: A countertop workspace is shown with a small cardboard box of brightly colored cloths near the right side, and an empty area of counter to the left. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps a yellow cloth from the top of the box as a right-hand object, lifts it up and left, then releases it onto the counter; the right hand immediately reaches back into the box, gathers multiple cloths into a right-hand object, lifts them out, and tosses them leftward onto the growing pile.
